The '''2026 Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council election''' took place on Thursday 7 May 2026, alongside [[2026 United Kingdom local elections|other local elections in the United Kingdom]]. All 54 members of [[Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council]] in [[West Yorkshire]] were elected following boundary changes.

== Background ==
Calderdale was created in 1974 as a [[metropolitan borough]]. The [[Conservative Party (UK)|Conservatives]] held control until [[1976 Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council election|1976]], when the council fell into [[no overall control]].<ref>{{cite web |title=BBC News – Election 2011 – England council elections – Calderdale |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/special/election2011/council/html/cy.stm |website=BBC News |access-date=27 January 2026}}</ref> [[Labour Party (UK)|Labour]] formed their first majority in [[1990 Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council election|1990]] and remained the largest party until [[1999 Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council election|1999]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council Election Results 1973–2012 |url=https://www.electionscentre.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/Calderdale-1973-2012.pdf |website=Elections Centre |access-date=27 January 2026}}</ref> The Conservatives last held a majority from [[2000 Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council election|2000]] to [[2002 Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council election|2002]]; following over a decade of no overall control, Labour won a majority of seats in [[2019 Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council election|2019]] and have held control since.<ref>{{cite news |title=Election results: Labour gains Calderdale Council |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-leeds-48145247 |access-date=27 January 2026 |date=3 May 2019}}</ref>

This election was held on a new set of ward boundaries – as such, all seats were up for election.<ref>[https://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/1182/made The Calderdale (Electoral Changes) Order 2024].</ref> The number of three-member wards increased by one.
